dataset.label_source_note: authored fixture labels, not measured model correctness

evaluation_method.split: stratified by label x group, 80/20 train/test, random_state=42
evaluation_method.cv: stratified 5-fold on the 80% train split, per-fold F1 for the stronger class
evaluation_method.test: held-out 20% test set; accuracy, precision, recall and F1 for the stronger class
evaluation_method.confusion_matrix: rows are true labels, columns are predicted labels, order economy then stronger
evaluation_method.threshold: out-of-fold predicted probabilities on the train split; maximise F1, ties to 0.5

threshold.method: out-of-fold train probabilities (5-fold), F1-maximising, ties closest to 0.5

economy.note: Authored policy offset: balanced + 0.15, clipped to [0.05, 0.95].

balanced.note: F1-maximising threshold from out-of-fold train probabilities (authored labels), kept inside [0.2, 0.8] so the policy offsets stay ordered.

quality.note: Authored policy offset: balanced - 0.15, clipped to [0.05, 0.95].

notes: Routing labels are authored fixtures. Metrics show how well the classifiers reproduce those labels, not real model answer quality, routing savings or provider behaviour.
Dataset: 300 authored prompts; the held-out test set has 60 rows, so metric uncertainty is high.
Primary model is random_forest because its cross-validation F1 clearly beat logistic regression by at least 0.02; logistic regression is also saved as an interpretable baseline.
Balanced threshold 0.5296 maximises out-of-fold F1 (0.9048) on the train split; ties go to the value closest to 0.5.
Policy thresholds are authored offsets, not learned or certified values. score >= threshold routes to the stronger tier; score < threshold routes to economy.
Per-group accuracy uses only the held-out test rows; several groups have very few rows (see per_group_accuracy support), so these values are indicative, not guarantees.
No hyperparameters were tuned on the test set.
MLP did not converge within 500 iterations (n_iter=500); its test metrics may understate a longer training run.
